text: {"answer":"It first uses the explicit `no_proxy` value, or falls back to the `no_proxy`/`NO_PROXY` environment variable. URLs without a hostname bypass proxies. For IPv4 hosts, it bypasses when an entry is a matching IP or CIDR network; for other hosts, it bypasses when the hostname or hostname-with-port ends with a `no_proxy` entry. If no match is found, it calls `proxy_bypass()` and bypasses when that returns true; errors from that call result in no bypass.","file":"utils.py","line":765}
